dsp GenBell04 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.822312 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 5.392 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 6.302 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 1.0692

dsp GenBell05 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.902109 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.859 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.871 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.055 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 6.897 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.0426

dsp GenBell08 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.648294 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.926 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.413 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 7.577 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.1124

dsp GenBell09 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.478541 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 5.918 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 6.146 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 0.9670

  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0

    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.929 / sr))

    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 3.283 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 4.419492 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.852 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.421 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 3.434 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 6.959 / sr))
    set previous := gate

dsp GenBell13 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.230191 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.045 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.939 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 7.421 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.1007

dsp GenBell16 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.597261 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.454 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.127 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 1.0429

dsp GenBell17 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.646193 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.695 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.174 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 3.96 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.54 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.1861

dsp GenBell20 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.444847 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.475 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.401 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 6.411 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.0777

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.518236 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 4.832 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.282 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.991 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.108 / sr))
    set previous := gate

dsp GenBell24 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.163576 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 4.906 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.275 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.676 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.496 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.1048

dsp GenBell27 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.640964 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.382 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.011 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 0.9016

dsp GenBell28 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.372209 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 6.516 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 6.951 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 1.0511

dsp GenBell31 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.925021 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.272 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.657 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 4.032 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.0150

dsp GenBell32 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.241401 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.226 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.896 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.537 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.0287

dsp GenBell35 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.26232 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.053 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.147 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 3.932 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.767 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.0098

dsp GenBell36 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.90766 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.501 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.59 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 4.558 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.391 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.1650

dsp GenBell39 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 4.415912 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.073 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.207 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 1.0263

dsp GenBell42 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.779703 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 5.134 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 6.247 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 6.589 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.913 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.1525

dsp GenBell43 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 4.721575 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 4.757 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 6.482 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.094 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.1359
